incidents.name: Rugged Art RuggedMarket targetedPurchase arbitrary router call
incidents.notes: RuggedMarket.targetedPurchase() forwarded attacker-supplied UniversalRouter commands and inputs without validating them, letting a flash-loan-funded caller sweep the market's RUGGED balance and NFTs and then unstake against it.

sources.ref: onchain review: proxy 0x2648f5592c09a260C601ACde44e7f8f2944944Fb created 2024-02-15 by 0xe2b2a4b7ef40ccc1392a680a0e1e74f7efdd87ea (not the attacker or the attack-tx sender 0x9733303117504c146a4e22261f2685ddb79780ef); two EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2024-02-17T00:23:47Z installing implementation 0xfe380fe1db07e531e3519b9ae3ea9f7888ce20c6 (the address the PoC labels RuggedMarket), so the executing code was 2.57 days old at the incident. ~5 ETH at a February 2024 ETH price of roughly $2,900 is well above the $1,000 floor. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 5 ETH x $2,897.20 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $14,486.
